title: Evidence Item
description: Provenance and metadata for a single piece of evidence in the evidence-first litigation workflow.

evidence_id.description: Unique evidence identifier in format EV-YYYY-NNNNN (e.g., EV-2026-00001).

description.description: Human-readable description of this evidence item.

source_category.description: High-level category for the Master Evidence Index.

source_entity.description: Name of the organization or entity that originated this document.

document_type.description: Type of document (e.g., deficiency_notice, credit_report, account_statement, letter).

filename.description: Filename of the evidence file as stored in the case directory.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex hash of the evidence file.

acquisition_date.description: ISO 8601 date on which the evidence was acquired (received, downloaded, photographed, etc.).

obtained_from.description: Name of the person, organization, or system from which the evidence was obtained.

authenticity_status.description: Current authenticity assessment: verified = document has been confirmed as genuine; pending = verification not yet performed; questioned = authenticity is in doubt; unverifiable = cannot be authenticated with available means.

verification_status.description: Hash/integrity verification status: verified = SHA-256 has been independently confirmed; pending = not yet verified; failed = hash mismatch detected; not_applicable = original digital file unavailable.

verification.description: Structured verification record. Populated when verification_status is verified or failed.

verified_at.description: UTC timestamp when verification was performed.

verified_by.description: Name or system identifier of the verifier.

verification_method.description: Method used to verify authenticity or integrity.

verification_notes.description: Additional notes from the verification process.

verification_artifact_sha256.description: Optional: SHA-256 of a verification receipt or attestation document.

registered_at.description: UTC timestamp when this evidence item was registered in the system.

custodian.description: Name or role of the person responsible for maintaining this evidence item.

related_claim_ids.description: CLAIM-{ID} entries supported by this evidence item.

notes.description: Free-text notes about this evidence item.
